{{dablink|For other uses of the word "tower," see [[Tower]].}}
'''Heeth Tower''' is a [[Kandor]]i border tower that lies on the edge of the [[Blight]] border, under the command of [[Malenarin Rai]]. It is part of a chain of watchtowers to guard against the Blight. The chain uses a combination of mirrors to warn and communicate with other towers in the chain all the way to the capital of [[Chachin]].
